ast.scope: Child source-bound partial syntax; no composed semantic AST.

obernants.assumptions: CPU/GPU runtime and Candle kernels trusted beyond finite checks. CUDA tests serial on RTX4000 SFF Ada, compile cap89, two build jobs. Explicit CUDA Device::new_cuda calls do not depend on GP_CPU; CPU prediction uses GP_FUSED_SOFTMAX=0. Original model/corpus timing and optimizer experiments not executed. No full mathematical/semantic AST proof or percent-error surrogate.
obernants.domain: UTF-8 and valid Sent/Batch coordinates; Eisner square matrices with representable finite intermediate candidate sums for chart/backtrace tie guarantees, with special empty/singleton early branches. Exact-real maximum-tree interpretation additionally requires exact arithmetic or order-preservation across every rounded comparison. Net requires max_len>0, heads>0,d divisible heads, valid indices, resources and CUDA for selected ignored synthetic tests. No live model/corpus.
obernants.observation_scope: data::batch roles index (k*T+d)*T+p; Net attention uses B,H,T,dh and masks head/key columns. lib transposes arcs dependent-major into Eisner head-major and maps local decoded h to flattened k*T+h for Net::rels. An adapter using raw h for k>0 gathers another sentence's encoder state. Vocs labels require same ordering as model output dimensions; load files independently and missing weights are not consistency proof. CLI score zips and can hide length mismatches, so output-length invariants must be checked before claiming dataset coverage. Existing world GPU caller uses parse_forms; tokenization remains caller-owned. Tests are sibling observers, not runtime production stages.
obernants.operator: Within representable finite candidate sums, decoded tree cannot have multiple roots; no analogous guarantee is made for nonfinite recurrence defaults or copied overlength trees. Empty slots never enter reductions. Public training fusion uses differentiable softmax. Missing tensors preserve initialization, without rollback promise.

obernants.operator: Output preimages include discarded text fields, vocab/hash collisions and rounded f32 decoder decision regions; exact-real score cones describe them only under order-preservation. Softmax positive rows admit log(p)+constant; f32 zero can be underflow. Checkpoints omit optimizer moments, corpus and RNG history.

obernants.operator: Batch row=k*T+i; tensor arc cell=(k*T+d)*T+h; decoder sc[h][d] receives that cell; relation head=k*T+h. Root index0 is local per sentence and never a real loss row.
